source: TRA-600: identity of the 9 duplicate label groups, MusicBrainz + Wikidata (looked up 2026-10-18)

evidence: Not this one: MusicBrainz ad6f8706-c95e-443b-8579-8e3ecd27126c (Columbia Records, EMI 1931-1990, UK) is Q1112471 on its own side
Not these: Epic Records Japan (74d4bedc-649c-4855-89ec-c3ec02e68861, Q846383), Epic Records Germany (3da55ce4-7c2e-4f05-b546-1049c3536ea2, Q96743129)
Not this one: E.G. Records, The Whitlams' own label (abb08659-386b-42ca-be00-c20ba8d5f29d)

Homonyms ruled out, six MusicBrainz labels are named Axis Records: Dutch dance 520dd37f-a5d2-4647-8959-42b2d764a6e0, San Francisco techno/industrial 13cbd0e9-0acc-4900-abc2-06812c517b86, UK metal 1986-88 b028249b-f96d-44ff-aa25-c4569e1b4d1e, Polish 1999-2005 a53f1728-c423-431e-958a-e7686d1b41e8, 4AD precursor 1979 d6025dee-9ac4-4790-ac52-b83bb032b23e, Poughquag NY c46820db-f182-402a-b561-d37f98768ba9

Both cache articles describe Jeff Mills' label, founded 1992 (anchor), rosters Jeff Mills / Robert Hood / X-102; the Miami location of label:axis-records is an error of that article, not a second label

groups.reason: MusicBrainz and Wikidata both keep two entities: Virgin (imprint, 49b58bdb-3d74-40c6-956a-4c4b46115c9c, Q50133002) and Virgin Records (84009bd4-0ba1-411e-a952-78e6f9428572, Q203059, different from Q2513768). Neither says the two cache nodes are one label.

No identifier links the two sources: MusicBrainz KMS (6b271325-b78a-4002-8ae6-e3ecaa91347b, 1987, Detroit) has no Wikidata relation and Wikidata Q1718826 (KMS Records) has no P966. Name, year and country agree, which is not a proof. Reopen when one side gets the link.
